data.description: 【伊冯 · 基地食堂】基地食堂的午间，伊冯端着餐盘从人群里挤出来，自拍休闲装的口袋里还插着手机，尾巴在身后快活地摆动——「干饭不积极，思想有问题！本天才永远准时。」
data.promptProse: Yvonne steps out of the base canteen crowd carrying her meal tray, a smartphone tucked into her casual cropped-jacket pocket. Her tail swings behind practical trousers and sneakers. The medium view keeps the tray in front and neighboring tables receding around her. Noon daylight through canteen windows brightens the food and her cheerful face, with softer overlapping shadows between the diners farther behind.
data.title: 伊冯 · 基地食堂
